findings.message: The definitions exposed two write forms but no command-input state; added cadastrarItemCardapioDraft and atualizarItemCardapioDraft with public setters.
The definitions exposed a select entry parameter without a selection function; added selectItemCardapio(id) and the formularioItemCardapio selected-record getter.
The command definitions update pagina but return an item rather than a page; used the returned item for item and reloaded carregarItensCardapio as required by both route purposes.
